_comment: Files behind GET /v1/companion/download/{platform}. The redirect records the hit, then 302s here. Windows has one file per CPU; x64 is the default when the site cannot tell. Mac goes to the Mac App Store listing (2026-10-22); the DMG and its Sparkle appcast stay up for existing installs. Change a file by editing this doc (scoped sync), not by deploying.
